question: Should the protected maintainer-owned Markdown contract tests be landed after a current-main refresh?
rationale: The patch is narrow and test-only, but the protected label requires an explicit maintainer decision rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Refresh and land
options.body: Rebase or rerun the focused channel tests on the current merge result, then merge the contract coverage if the pinned output remains intentional.

options.title: Narrow the contract scope
options.body: Request edits only if maintainers want less of the adapter's current byte-level behavior treated as a long-term public contract.
